label: Desktop nav links row (main nav items with Ofertas CTA)

iterations.issuesSummary: text-transform uppercase, font-size 14px, letter-spacing 0.5px, padding mismatch, font-weight 700

fixesApplied: Changed text-transform from uppercase to none on .nav-item .nav-link
Changed font-weight from 700 to 400 on .nav-item .nav-link and .nav-tools .nav-cta
Changed letter-spacing from 0.5px to normal on .nav-item .nav-link and .nav-tools .nav-cta
Changed nav link padding from 20px 0 to 10px 20px with height 60px
Changed nav-list gap from 32px to 0 (spacing handled by link padding)
Changed .nav-cta text-transform from uppercase to none, font-size to 16px, border-radius to 0
Changed .nav-cta height to 60px to match header bar height

notes: Both source and migrated headers use transparent backgrounds. The visual similarity was measured with a temporary solid dark background (#1a1a2e) injected via JavaScript on the migrated nav-wrapper to normalize the screenshot backgrounds for comparison. The font-family differs (HyundaiSansHead-Bold vs roboto) which is expected since the custom Hyundai font is not available in the EDS project. All other text styling properties now match the source.
